title: Tube laser cutting machines
subtitle: Dener E-FTL and FTL tube and profile fiber lasers · Ø0.3″ to 25.2″ · 3 to 20 kW · bundle loaders
cover_line: Dener Makina · made in Turkey · sold & serviced in Canada by NovoTech
about_title: From a bundle of tube to finished parts, without an operator at the machine
about_text: A tube laser cuts round, square, rectangular and open profiles to length and cuts the holes, copes, slots and notches in them in one pass, straight from the 3D model — no saw, no drill, no notcher, no layout. Dener builds two lines: the E-FTL, with servo chucks accelerating at 1 G to 394 ft/min for tube from Ø0.3″ to 13.8″, and the heavy FTL for structural tube and pipe to Ø25.2″ and 12 m bars weighing up to 2,600 kg. Both load from a bundle automatically, support the tube as it is cut, nest parts along the bar and unload the finished pieces; fiber sources from 3 to 20 kW and 5-axis bevel heads for weld preparations.

Dener Makina has built sheet-metal and laser machinery in Kayseri since 1974 and exports to more than 100 countries. NovoTech sells, installs and supports the machines in Canada from Mississauga, Ontario — layout for your building, installation, operator training, a CSA-approved panel, a 1-year warranty and parts stocked by Dener Canada.
